name: Zainab Noor
title: Instructional Designer
tagline: Hi, Zay here. I design training experiences that close skill gaps, engage employees, and drive measurable performance across your organization.
aboutBio: I'm an Instructional Designer with a passion for making workplace learning actually work. With a background in curriculum development and corporate training, I partner with L&D teams and business leaders to design programs that move the needle — not just check the compliance box.

My approach is always learner-centered and business-focused. Before I design a single slide or write a single learning objective, I ask: What does this person need to do differently after training? And what's getting in their way right now? That clarity shapes everything.

Over the years, I've worked with organizations across industries — from fast-growing startups building their first onboarding programs to established enterprises modernizing legacy training content. Whether the deliverable is a polished e-learning module, a facilitator guide, or a blended learning journey, I bring the same rigor, creativity, and attention to learner experience.

What I bring to every project:
A strategic lens — I design for outcomes, not just outputs
Strong collaboration skills — I work closely with SMEs, LMS admins, and stakeholders to keep projects on track
Proficiency in Articulate Storyline 360, Rise, Canva, and common LMS platforms
A commitment to quality — every module is reviewed for instructional integrity, accessibility, and engagement before delivery
